stem: Which sentence supports the idea that Brittany is concerned about her friendship with Alix?

options.label: F
options.text: With that, Alix turned and headed toward the exit. (paragraph 4)

options.label: G
options.text: Brittany stared at the empty stands, imagining how she must have made Alix feel. (paragraph 9)

options.label: H
options.text: Alix placed her hands on Brittany's shoulders and gave her a little shake. (paragraph 14)

options.label: J
options.text: She saw Alix, giving two thumbs up, and Brittany envisioned the judges giving her the same gesture after her routine. (paragraph 15)
